ops-bot: Announcement: limited canary for Dedicated L50E + B300 in ap-southeast-7 (chiang-mai-cnx-1). 72h staged rollout, new reservations paused for 14 days. :thai:

nina.prod: L50E is our low-power L-series for edge/quant workloads; B300 is a burst-optimized box for low-p95. Quick bench: L50E shows ~17% token cost reduction on 5-6k contexts vs A100x when using our recommended int8 profile.

raja-sre: Infra: starting footprint = 6 racks. Health gates: nvlink <0.12% and kernel OOMs flat. We'll push a non-disruptive livepatch at 02:15-02:35 UTC. Dashboards live under infra/canary/cnx.

oliver-sales: Please prepare embargoed messaging and temporary APAC pricing uplift for reps. Need a one-pager for strategic accounts.

maria-support: Support playbook: tag tickets "cnx-l50e" and collect model id, seq len, batch size for any latency reports. Escalate to #eng-runtime for nvlink or OOM traces.

ops-bot: Reservation exceptions require capacity form with customer id + expected QPS + preferred start: https://redwood.company/capacity-request. Reactions: :rocket: :flag-th:
